plan: My private value is $39. To maximize profit, I should bid below my value but high enough to outbid others. A bid slightly below $39, such as $38.9, ensures that if I win, I pay less than my value, maximizing profit. Given no history, assume competitors bid randomly. Bidding close to my value maximizes the chance of winning without overpaying.

Given my private value of $34, I aim to bid strategically to maximize profit. The optimal bid should be slightly below my value to ensure potential profit if I win while minimizing loss if I lose. I will bid $30, as it is below my value, allowing a profit margin if I win and pay the third-highest bid, which is likely lower. This bid balances risk and reward, considering the independent nature of each round.
